title: Mesa: exploración territorial de demostración
style: White field, flat geometry, rounded bars, circular nodes, petroleum titles. No neon, cyberpunk grid or invented data.

font_used_for_raster_only.note: Installed macOS font used for raster rendering only. No font file redistributed. Futura PT from PDF is not the same cut; this is the local Futura fallback.

geographic_source.circulation_authorization: Resolución Nº50 de 2019, Dirección Nacional de Fronteras y Límites del Estado

geographic_transformation: Supplied polygon kept in vertex order. X multiplied by cosine of average latitude then uniform scaling/translation for visual display.
demo_content: Exactly three schematic exploration nodes and a cycling activity cue; no claimed real quantities. Label Contenido de demostración is always visible.
